_comment: Advisory capability gradings for models an operator serves on their own hardware. NEVER routable - ai_endpoints.json is the only file that says where a request may be sent. This file answers one question about a local model: which capability rung is it on. Named entries win; the ladder is the fallback, matched against the parameter count parsed out of the model tag. See specs/joinery_ai_model_capability_resolution.md.

models.evidence: email_security_corpus 2026-08-20, 100 msgs: 96% recall / 4% FP at score >=7; mean phish 8.9 vs ham 0.3, hard negatives 1.1
